task.title: Pair A — control_plane snake/kebab importlib shim + import site rewrites
task.summary_zh: 實作 migration map Pair A (P1)：services/control_plane (snake) 跟 services/control-plane (kebab) 同名衝突。控制節點 - control-plane 含 hyphen 不是合法 Python package，因此實作 importlib shim：(1) 把 services/control_plane/internal_api.py + internal_api_min.py 搬到 services/control-plane/internal/；(2) 新建 services/control_plane/internal/__init__.py + internal_api.py + internal_api_min.py 用 importlib.util.spec_from_file_location 載入 kebab tree 內的實作；(3) 保留 services/control_plane/internal_api*.py 當 legacy wrapper re-export 新 shim；(4) rewrite 5 個 import sites：services/runtime-manager/internal_api_routes.py:210, smoke_test.py:416, test_internal_api_routes.py:70, test_runtime_hardening.py:343, tests/run_internal_api_smoke.py:4；(5) 全部 import 改成 services.control_plane.internal.internal_api / internal_api_min；(6) 跑 services/runtime-manager 的 pytest + tests/run_internal_api_smoke.py 證明沒 regression；(7) docker-compose 不變。詳見 docs/architecture/services-namespace-migration-map-2026-05-10.md §3.1 與 §4 Pair A rewrites。
